prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Preview Pet Soundscapes", "Listen to and choose the ambient sounds and cheerful cues your desktop pet makes.", "Play Gentle Chirp"]
1: ["Select Your Desktop Companion Archetype", "Explore Archetypes"]
2: []
3: ["Try Your Desktop Controls", "Practice right-clicking, dragging, and calling your pet on your desktop screen now.", "Interactive Practice"]
4: ["Your Companion is Awakening", "We are assembling your pet's desktop assets and animation rigs.", "Pet Tip: Press hotkeys anytime to summon your pet back to the center of your screen."]
5: ["Welcome Your New Desktop Companion", "Find your pet in your system tray or use Ctrl+Shift+P to summon it anytime.", "System Tray Quick Control"]
6: ["Claim Your Companion & Starter Accessory", "Sign the certificate to unlock a free starter hat for your desktop pet!"]
7: ["Select Your Desktop Companion Path", "Choose Instant Adoption for instant desktop fun, or Custom Creation to upload your own photos."]
8: ["Protect Your Desktop Pet Memory", "Sign in to back up your companion's traits and ensure seamless recovery across desktop restarts.", "Pet Memory Secured"]
9: ["Upload clear, well-lit photos for accurate custom pet creation.", "Good lighting | Clear face view | High contrast"]
